purpose: R1.17.2 (corrected delivery) — the ORIGINAL A2/D2 obligations on the 46f078e baseline, exactly the return-for-correction items and nothing more (no new capability, no Phase-5 scope claim, no substitute counterexample). RED→GREEN evidence: the companion posidon-r1172-original-proof suite (the 23-test integration suite + harness extensions + the TWO ORIGINAL tests) was reproduced RED on the untouched baseline 46f078e — 2 failed / 23 skipped, exit 1, counterexample outputs byte-identical to the task ({ORIGINAL A2: outcome ack:retry_scheduled, relationCalls:1, durableRows:0, draftProviderCalls:0} and {ORIGINAL D2: outcome ack:job_completed, elapsedMs:20000, lateReferenceReads:1, relationCalls:0}) — evidence log logs/73-posidon-r1172-original-red-46f078e.log — and GREEN after the corrections (A2 {relationCalls:1, durableRows:1, draftProviderCalls:0}; D2 {lateReferenceReads:0, relationCalls:0}). (A2 fix) The handler's ENTIRE post-relation region — the drafting await through observeAiRun/classification, the deferred/permanent/no-traced-claim recordings, the evidence-guard/document/commit-input construction and the fenced commit with its catalog/basis/content/snapshot/fence outcomes — sits inside ONE attempt-scoped cleanup: EVERY exceptional exit records, BEFORE the engine schedules the retry, (a) the union of the record-time attempt observations with the outcome-mapped rows (deterministic per-(job,generation,pair,attempt) ids; the fenced standalone insert's own-row guard dedups) and (b) the draft run when one was actually observed — an exception BEFORE the provider call observes nothing and NO row is fabricated; each audit type is recorded INDEPENDENTLY (a failure cleaning one never skips the other when its store works); the original error then propagates UNCHANGED (the engine's typed bounded retry owns the outcome; the charge stays — no refund, no re-inference, no exactly-once claim; a persistent store outage can still defeat the best-effort record — an honest limitation). The ownership fence, the generation separation and the previous observer-first work are preserved. (D2 fix) The SAME absolute step deadline is re-checked IMMEDIATELY BEFORE every new asynchronous operation: the reference-row read after a candidate draft resolved (a RETURNED — not pending — basis read does not prove time remains; the deadline primitive cannot retract an already-started eager query) and the hash/bundle work in the pair-bundling loop; an expired clock starts NO query and builds NO bundle — the candidate is the typed technical state basis_unavailable/step_deadline_expired (never a semantic verdict, never a fake empty successful lookup). The bounded pending-probe/basis races, the late-rejection absorption, the ≤2/≤3 caps, the shared budget and the separate drafting deadline are preserved; product SQL shapes and gates unchanged.
